Description:
Description
California Gold Nutrition® Ultamins Men’s Multivitamin
Vitamin and Mineral Blend with CoQ10, Lycopene, Lutein, and Methyl B12
Featuring Veggie, Berry, and Immune Mushroom Blends
Supports a Healthy Lifestyle and Well-Balanced Diet*
Individually Sealed in Foil Blisters
Formulated without Gluten, GMOs, or Soy
Produced in an Audited and Registered cGMP Compliant Facility

We’re excited to share that Ultamins are now a part of California Gold Nutrition family of products. You can expect the same quality formulas and ingredients, just with a new look and a new family of best-in-class products to further support your health.
Unlock your true potential and elevate your well-being with Men’s Multivitamin. Crafted with meticulous care, this premium formula combines a powerful blend of mushrooms, enzymes, veggies, berries, and key nutrients like CoQ10, lycopene, lutein, and bioavailable methyl B12 to provide you with the essential support your body needs to thrive.
Coenzyme Q10 (Ubiquinone)
We know that energy is the fuel that propels you through the day. Our Men’s Multivitamin delivers a generous dose of 100 mg of CoQ10 per serving, a vital nutrient that plays a crucial role in cellular energy production. By supporting mitochondrial function, CoQ10 helps vitalize your body at the cellular level, providing a sustainable boost to your overall energy levels.*
Mushroom Immune Complex
Harness the strength of nature’s superheroes with our specifically curated mushroom blend. These remarkable fungi, known for their immune-boosting and adaptogenic properties, work tirelessly to fortify your immune system, promote resilience, and support overall vitality.*
Berry Fruit Powder Blend and Vegetable Antioxidant Powder Blend
Give your body the nourishment it craves with our nutrient-rich blend of veggies and berries. Packed with an array of vitamins, minerals, and potent antioxidants, these natural wonders provide exceptional support against oxidative stress, helping to combat cellular damage and promote overall health and longevity.* Fuel your body with the goodness it deserves.
Enzyme Blend
We understand that a healthy digestive system is the key to unlocking the full potential of your nutrition. That’s why our Men’s Multivitamin includes a carefully selected blend of enzymes. These digestive powerhouses work synergistically to support optimal digestion and nutrient absorption.* By improving your body’s ability to break down and utilize essential nutrients, our multivitamin ensures that you receive maximum benefit from every dose.

iTested Verified
Suggested use
Take 2 capsules daily, with food. Best when taken as directed by a qualified healthcare professional.
Other ingredients
Main Ingredients
Coenzyme Q10 (Ubiquinone)
Mushroom Immune Complex
Berry Fruit Powder Blend
Vegetable Antioxidant Powder Blend
Enzyme Blend
Other Ingredients
Modified Cellulose (Hypromellose Veggie Capsule), Potassium Chloride, Microcrystalline Cellulose, Magnesium Stearate, Silicon Dioxide (Silica), Maltodextrin, Vegetable Starch, and Sunflower Lecithin.
Formulated with Aquamin® F, Aquamin® TG Sea Minerals, VitaBerry®, and VitaVeggie®. Aquamin® F and Aquamin® TG Sea Minerals are registered trademarks of Marigot Limited. VitaBerry® is a registered trademark of VDF FutureCeuticals, Inc. VitaVeggie® is a registered trademark of VDF FutureCeuticals, Inc.
Not manufactured with milk, eggs, fish, crustacean shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soy, sesame, or gluten. Produced in an FDA-registered, third-party audited, and cGMP compliant facility that may process other products that contain these allergens or ingredients.
Warnings
Keep out of reach of children. Pregnant or lactating women, the chronically ill, elderly, individuals under the age of 18, those taking prescription medications (e.g., blood thinners) as well as those with a physician-diagnosed medical condition should consult with a physician, pharmacist, naturopath or other qualified healthcare professional prior to taking dietary supplements.
Sealed for your protection. Do not use if individually sealed blister pack are punctured or damaged. Store in a cool, dry place. Protect from heat, light, and moisture.
